content: Discogs API supports two auth modes: (1) User-token (personal access token generated at Settings > Developers > Generate new token) — simplest, sufficient for single-user scripts reading/writing own wantlist/collection; token passed as query param or Authorization header. (2) OAuth 1.0a — needed only for multi-user apps acting on behalf of others; requires Consumer Key/Secret + 3-legged flow (request_token/authorize/access_token). For a single-operator personal tool, personal access token is correct and sufficient.
